basic_profile.bio: I'm a 23-year-old bisexual male from Australia, currently working as a freelance graphic designer. I've always been fascinated by the blend of art and technology, which led me to pursue a career in digital design. During my downtime, I love watching college basketball, especially games involving my favorite team, the Jayhawks. I'm also an avid learner, often diving into online courses about new design software and techniques. I'm single and enjoy meeting new people, particularly those who share my interests in art and sports. I usually browse Reddit during the late evenings after work. My dislikes include narrow-mindedness and people who can't appreciate a good sense of humor.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a Bachelor’s degree in Graphic Design from a local university in Australia. My expertise lies in digital illustration and UX/UI design, which I honed through both formal education and years of self-teaching via online platforms like Coursera and Skillshare.
